note: Для дуже високих показників. Для 95%+ можна також «almost all» / «virtually all».
example: The vast majority of participants said they felt motivated by exams. (85%)

exercises.practice: 90% of employees said they were satisfied with remote work.
exercises.answer: The vast majority of employees said they were satisfied with remote work. (90%)
exercises.answerNote: Число прибираємо на початок речення і замінюємо фразою; сам відсоток можна лишити в дужках для контролю.

exercises.practice: Out of all the respondents surveyed, 88% reported that they exercise at least once a week.
exercises.answer: Out of all the respondents surveyed, the vast majority reported that they exercise at least once a week. (88%)
exercises.answerNote: Тут фраза стає не на початку, а всередині речення — після вставного звороту.

exercises.recommendedPhrase: the vast majority / only a handful
exercises.practice: 90% of students preferred online classes, while just 6% preferred in-person lessons.
exercises.answer: The vast majority of students preferred online classes, whereas only a handful opted for in-person lessons. (90% vs 6%)
exercises.answerNote: Поєднали дві фрази в одному порівняльному реченні через "whereas".

note: Точна дріб — вживай, коли число дуже близьке до 75%.
example: Three quarters of students reported feeling anxious during exam week. (75%)

exercises.practice: 76% of the group said they prefer working from home.
exercises.answer: Three quarters of the group said they prefer working from home. (76%)
exercises.answerNote: 76% округлюємо до найближчої «зручної» дробі — three quarters.

exercises.practice: According to the survey, 74% of participants admitted they check their phone within five minutes of waking up.
exercises.answer: According to the survey, three quarters of participants admitted they check their phone within five minutes of waking up. (74%)
exercises.answerNote: Фраза стоїть після вступного звороту "according to the survey".

exercises.recommendedPhrase: three quarters / just over a tenth
exercises.practice: 75% of teenagers said they use social media daily, compared to only 12% of people over 60.
exercises.answer: Three quarters of teenagers said they use social media daily, compared to just over a tenth of those aged over 60. (75% vs 12%)
exercises.answerNote: Обидві частини речення тепер фрази, а не цифри — природніше для Task 1.

note: Трохи більше за 2/3 (66.7%) — more than two thirds / just over two thirds.
example: 68% said they studied more seriously before exams → More than two thirds said they studied more seriously before exams. (68%)

exercises.practice: 68% of the workforce said they would like more flexible hours.
exercises.answer: More than two thirds of the workforce said they would like more flexible hours. (68%)
exercises.answerNote: 68% трохи вище за 66.7%, тому просто «two thirds» вже не точно — додаємо «more than».

exercises.practice: In the city surveyed, as many as 67% of residents reported using public transport at least once a week.
exercises.answer: In the city surveyed, more than two thirds of residents reported using public transport at least once a week. (67%)
exercises.answerNote: "as many as" — типовий вступ перед великим числом, фраза стає підметом одразу після нього.

exercises.recommendedPhrase: more than two thirds / a small minority
exercises.practice: 68% of respondents said exams motivated them, whereas only 15% said exams had no effect.
exercises.answer: More than two thirds of respondents said exams motivated them, whereas only a small minority reported no effect. (68% vs 15%)
exercises.answerNote: Поєднання двох фраз через "whereas" — стандартна конструкція для протиставлення.

note: Трохи більше половини. Не плутай з «nearly half» (менше 50%).
example: Over half of learners said exams helped them stay organised. (52%)

exercises.practice: 53% of customers said they would recommend the product to a friend.
exercises.answer: Just over half of customers said they would recommend the product to a friend. (53%)
exercises.answerNote: "just over half" точніше за просте "over half", коли число близьке саме до 50%.

exercises.practice: When asked about their commute, 51% of employees admitted that they spend more than an hour travelling each way.
exercises.answer: When asked about their commute, just over half of employees admitted that they spend more than an hour travelling each way. (51%)
exercises.answerNote: Фраза органічно вписалась після підрядного звороту "when asked about...".

exercises.recommendedPhrase: just over half / just under a third
exercises.practice: 52% of parents said they limit screen time, while 31% said they do not monitor it at all.
exercises.answer: Just over half of parents said they limit screen time, while just under a third admitted they do not monitor it at all. (52% vs 31%)
exercises.answerNote: Обидва відсотки замінили на фрази — рівень Band 7+ у Task 1.

example: Nearly half of people said they became more competitive. (46%)

exercises.practice: 47% of drivers admitted to using their phone while driving at least once.
exercises.answer: Nearly half of drivers admitted to using their phone while driving at least once. (47%)
exercises.answerNote: 47% округлюємо в бік «half», але додаємо «nearly», бо не досягає 50%.

exercises.practice: Of those surveyed about diet, 45% reported that they try to avoid sugar completely.
exercises.answer: Of those surveyed about diet, nearly half reported that they try to avoid sugar completely. (45%)
exercises.answerNote: "of those surveyed about diet" — типовий вступ, фраза йде відразу після коми.

exercises.recommendedPhrase: nearly half / roughly one in four
exercises.practice: 46% of respondents said they cook every day, whereas 24% said they rarely cook at all.
exercises.answer: Nearly half of respondents said they cook every day, whereas roughly one in four said they rarely cook at all. (46% vs 24%)
exercises.answerNote: "roughly one in four" — альтернативний спосіб сказати 25%, звучить природніше за "a quarter" у розмовному контексті.

note: Помітна, але не більшість — коли немає зручного дробу для округлення.
example: A significant proportion of people felt nervous before oral exams. (40%)

exercises.practice: 41% of small businesses said rising costs were their biggest concern.
exercises.answer: A significant proportion of small businesses said rising costs were their biggest concern. (41%)
exercises.answerNote: "a significant proportion" підходить для чисел приблизно 35–45%, коли немає зручного дробу.

exercises.practice: Among the teenagers interviewed, 39% said they had never read a physical newspaper.
exercises.answer: Among the teenagers interviewed, a significant proportion said they had never read a physical newspaper. (39%)
exercises.answerNote: Фраза замінює число після вступного звороту "among the teenagers interviewed".

exercises.recommendedPhrase: a significant proportion / the vast majority
exercises.practice: 40% of office workers said they wanted to work from home permanently, while 85% said they wanted at least some flexibility.
exercises.answer: A significant proportion of office workers said they wanted to work from home permanently, while the vast majority wanted at least some flexibility. (40% vs 85%)
exercises.answerNote: Дві різні фрази в одному реченні показують, що "significant" і "vast majority" відрізняються за силою.

example: Just under a third of respondents said they improved their focus. (31%)

exercises.practice: 32% of graduates said they moved to a different city for their first job.
exercises.answer: Just under a third of graduates said they moved to a different city for their first job. (32%)
exercises.answerNote: 32% ближче до третини (33.3%), тому "just under a third" точніше за "roughly a third".

exercises.practice: In terms of transport choices, 30% of city residents reported cycling to work regularly.
exercises.answer: In terms of transport choices, just under a third of city residents reported cycling to work regularly. (30%)
exercises.answerNote: "in terms of" — типовий вступний зворот перед фразою-підметом.

exercises.recommendedPhrase: just under a third / over half
exercises.practice: 31% of participants said they save money regularly, whereas 52% said they rarely save at all.
exercises.answer: Just under a third of participants said they save money regularly, whereas over half admitted they rarely save at all. (31% vs 52%)
exercises.answerNote: Класична структура протиставлення двох фраз через "whereas".

formula: 22–26% → roughly one in four / about a quarter
example: Roughly one in four students lost interest in studying. (24%)

exercises.practice: 25% of respondents said they had changed careers in the last five years.
exercises.answer: Roughly one in four respondents said they had changed careers in the last five years. (25%)
exercises.answerNote: "one in four" — розмовний, наочний спосіб сказати 25%, часто вживається в Task 1.

exercises.practice: When it comes to diet, 23% of the group said they follow a vegetarian diet.
exercises.answer: When it comes to diet, roughly one in four of the group said they follow a vegetarian diet. (23%)
exercises.answerNote: Фраза працює і трохи нижче 25% — головне, щоб залишалась "приблизно".

exercises.recommendedPhrase: roughly one in four / more than two thirds
exercises.practice: 24% of workers said they felt burnt out, while 68% said they felt generally satisfied with their job.
exercises.answer: Roughly one in four workers said they felt burnt out, while more than two thirds reported feeling generally satisfied with their job. (24% vs 68%)
exercises.answerNote: Дві фрази різного масштабу в одному реченні підкреслюють контраст сильніше, ніж голі цифри.

example: A small minority of the class were excited about taking exams. (15%)

exercises.practice: 16% of shoppers said they always read reviews before buying online.
exercises.answer: A small minority of shoppers said they always read reviews before buying online. (16%)
exercises.answerNote: "a small minority" типово охоплює приблизно 10–20%.

exercises.practice: Regarding travel habits, 14% of those surveyed said they had never left their home country.
exercises.answer: Regarding travel habits, a small minority of those surveyed said they had never left their home country. (14%)
exercises.answerNote: Фраза стоїть після вступного звороту "regarding travel habits".

exercises.recommendedPhrase: a small minority / just over half
exercises.practice: 15% of employees said they dislike teamwork, compared to 52% who said they enjoy it.
exercises.answer: A small minority of employees said they dislike teamwork, compared to just over half who said they enjoy it. (15% vs 52%)
exercises.answerNote: "compared to" природно з'єднує дві фрази протилежного масштабу.

formula: 11–13% → just over a tenth / over one-tenth
example: Over one-tenth of the group said exams had no effect. (12%)

exercises.practice: 13% of tenants said they had disputed their rent increase.
exercises.answer: Just over a tenth of tenants said they had disputed their rent increase. (13%)
exercises.answerNote: "just over a tenth" — точніше за "over one-tenth", коли число майже точно 10%.

exercises.practice: With regard to savings habits, 11% of respondents admitted they save nothing each month.
exercises.answer: With regard to savings habits, just over a tenth of respondents admitted they save nothing each month. (11%)
exercises.answerNote: Фраза замінює число після офіційного вступу "with regard to".

exercises.recommendedPhrase: just over a tenth / the vast majority
exercises.practice: 12% of students said they never use a calculator, while 90% said they use one every day.
exercises.answer: Just over a tenth of students said they never use a calculator, while the vast majority use one every day. (12% vs 90%)
exercises.answerNote: Різкий контраст двох фраз показує різницю через слова, а не тільки цифри.

example: Only a few students enjoyed the pressure of exams. (5%)

exercises.practice: 4% of participants said they never feel stressed at work.
exercises.answer: Only a few participants said they never feel stressed at work. (4%)
exercises.answerNote: "only a few" — найпростіший спосіб сказати "дуже мало" для чисел до 5–6%.

exercises.practice: In response to the question about diet, 6% of people said they eat fast food every day.
exercises.answer: In response to the question about diet, only a few people said they eat fast food every day. (6%)
exercises.answerNote: Фраза йде після вступного звороту "in response to the question about...".

exercises.recommendedPhrase: only a few / the vast majority
exercises.practice: 5% of respondents said they dislike travelling, while 90% said they enjoy it a great deal.
exercises.answer: Only a few respondents said they dislike travelling, whereas the vast majority said they enjoy it a great deal. (5% vs 90%)
exercises.answerNote: Використали "whereas" замість "while" для більш формального стилю Task 1.
